description: Collaboration expense review: read the approval requests that just reached the owner's inbox, review them against the owner's guideline documents, email the owner a suggested decision.

globals.name: owner_email
globals.description: Owner mailbox address, set by Collaboration

globals.name: timezone
globals.description: Owner time zone the review is dated in, set by Collaboration

globals.name: thread_ids
globals.description: Brain thread id of each request, set by the mail import

globals.name: message_keys
globals.description: Brain message key of each request email, in the same order

globals.name: cc
globals.description: Addresses the owner copies each review to, set by Collaboration

nodes.label: Save drafts and email me the review

# Save the review's draft replies in the owner's Outlook drafts, never sent, then email them the review as # Deloitte-styled HTML; the only links are Outlook's own, to the requests and to the drafts. import html import json import re import bs4 import markdown from semoss import Insight TITLE = "Expense Review" FOOTER = ("Prepared by SEMOSS Collaboration from the approval request and your guideline documents. " "This is a suggested decision for your review; nothing was approved or declined, and no reply was sent " "on your behalf. Respond from the original request email or the MES Meeting & Event Approval Dashboard.") FONT = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" # Deloitte palette: black, Deloitte green (accents only; too light for text), cool grays, accessible link blue. BLACK = "#000000" GREEN = "#86BC25" GRAY_TEXT = "#53565A" GRAY_LINE = "#D0D0CE" GRAY_FILL = "#F2F2F2" BLUE = "#0076A8" MAX_SUBJECT = 120 # Outlook ignores most stylesheet CSS, so every element gets inline styles. STYLES = { "h1": "margin:24px 0 8px; padding:0 0 6px; border-bottom:2px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "h2": "margin:24px 0 8px; padding:0 0 6px; border-bottom:2px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "h3": "margin:16px 0 6px; font-size:15px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "p": "margin:0 0 10px;", "ul": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "ol": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "li": "margin:0 0 6px;", "a": "color:" + BLUE + "; text-decoration:underline;", "strong": "color:" + BLACK + ";", "table": "border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; margin:0 0 12px;", "th": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + "; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; text-align:left;", "td": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + ";", "blockquote": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:4px 12px; border-left:3px solid " + GREEN + "; color:" + GRAY_TEXT + ";", "code": "font-family:Consolas, monospace; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; padding:1px 4px;", "hr": "border:0; border-top:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + "; margin:16px 0;", } DECISION_STYLE = ("margin:14px 0; padding:10px 14px; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; border-left:4px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:15px; color:" + BLACK + ";") NOTE_STYLE = "margin:0 0 12px; font-size:13px; color:" + GRAY_TEXT + ";" # A Draft reply section's "To: ,
" line. TO_LINE = re.compile(r"^\s*to\s*:", re.I) ADDRESS = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+'-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+") def _pixel_value(name, value): # Pixel decodes \u escapes, so mail text can never open an tag in the Pixel. return name + "=[" + json.dumps(value).replace("<", "\\u003c") + "]" def _pixel(reactor, **args): ret = Insight().run_pixel(reactor + "(" + ", ".join(_pixel_value(k, v) for k, v in args.items()) + ");", raw=True) last = ret[0]["pixelReturn"][-1] if "ERROR" in str(last.get("operationType")): raise RuntimeError(reactor + " failed: " + str(last.get("output"))) return last.get("output") or {} def _request(heading, requests): # The request a draft answers: by the MES number in its review's heading, else the only request. review = heading.find_previous_sibling("h2") for number in re.findall(r"\((\d+)\)", review.get_text() if review else ""): found = [r for r in requests if "(" + number + ")" in str(r.get("subject") or "")] if len(found) == 1: return found[0] return requests[0] if len(requests) == 1 else None def _save_drafts(soup, requests, owner): # Each Draft reply section becomes a native Outlook reply to its request, quoting it, never sent. The model gives # only the text and the address, and an address outside the owner's organization is left off. domain = owner.rpartition("@")[2].lower() saved = [] # one draft per request, however many times the model repeats its review drafted = set() for heading in soup.find_all("h3"): if not heading.get_text().strip().lower().startswith("draft"): continue section = [] for tag in heading.find_next_siblings(): if tag.name in ("h1", "h2", "h3"): break section.append(tag) quote = next((tag for tag in section if tag.name == "blockquote"), None) blocks = (quote.find_all(recursive=False) or [quote]) if quote else [] to = " ".join(tag.get_text() for tag in [t for t in section if t is not quote] + blocks if TO_LINE.match(tag.get_text())) found = ADDRESS.search(to) address = found.group(0).lower() if found else "" if address.rpartition("@")[2] != domain and not address.endswith("." + domain): address = "" body = "\n\n".join(text for text in (b.get_text().strip() for b in blocks if not TO_LINE.match(b.get_text())) if text) request = _request(heading, requests) status = {"subject": request.get("subject") if request else None, "to": address, "saved": False} note, link = "This draft could not be saved in your Outlook drafts; copy it from here.", "" if request and request.get("messageId") in drafted: status["duplicate"] = True note = "A draft for this request is already in your Outlook drafts." elif request and request.get("messageId") and body: args = {"id": request["messageId"], "body": html.escape(body).replace("\n", "
"), "html": True, "overrideRecipients": True, "asDraft": True} if address: args["to"] = [address] try: link = str(_pixel("MicrosoftOutlookReplyMail", **args).get("webLink") or "") status["saved"] = True drafted.add(request["messageId"]) note = ("Saved in your Outlook drafts as a reply to the request" + ("." if address else ", with no recipient: add one before you send it.")) except Exception as e: status["error"] = str(e) saved.append(status) paragraph = soup.new_tag("p", style=NOTE_STYLE) paragraph.string = note if link.startswith("https://"): anchor = soup.new_tag("a", href=link, style=STYLES["a"]) anchor.string = "Open the draft" paragraph.append(" ") paragraph.append(anchor) (section or [heading])[-1].insert_after(paragraph) return saved def _links(requests): # The request's own Outlook link, from Graph, so the owner responds from the original email. items = "" for request in requests: label = html.escape(str(request.get("subject") or "Request")) link = str(request.get("webLink") or "") if link.startswith("https://"): label = '' + label + "" items += '
  • ' + label + "
    • " if not items: return "" return ('

    Respond from the original request

      ' + items + "
    ") def _email(content, date): return ( '' '
    ' '' '' '' '' '' '
    ' 'Deloitte' '.' '
    ' + TITLE + ' · ' + html.escape(date) + '
    ' '
     
    ' + content + '
    ' + FOOTER + '
    ' ) def run(scope): recipient = str(scope.get("owner_email") or "").strip() if not recipient: raise ValueError("There is no owner mailbox address to send to.") requests = list(scope["context"].get("requests") or []) # Thinking a model leaves in its answer ends at ; none of it is the review. review = str(scope["review"]).rpartition("")[2] # Escape raw HTML first, so only Markdown formatting reaches the email. escaped = review.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<") soup = bs4.BeautifulSoup(markdown.markdown(escaped, extensions=["tables"]), "html.parser") # the review starts at its first request heading; a lead-in written before it is dropped first = soup.find("h2") for tag in first.find_previous_siblings() if first else []: tag.decompose() for image in soup.find_all("img"): image.decompose() for link in soup.find_all("a"): # the model writes no links of its own; the request and draft links come from Outlook below link.unwrap() for tag in soup.find_all(list(STYLES)): tag["style"] = STYLES[tag.name] for paragraph in soup.find_all("p"): if paragraph.get_text().lstrip().lower().startswith("suggested decision"): paragraph["style"] = DECISION_STYLE drafts = _save_drafts(soup, requests, recipient) date = str(scope["context"]["today"]) body = _email(str(soup) + _links(requests), date) if len(requests) == 1 and requests[0].get("subject"): subject = str(requests[0]["subject"]).strip() subject = TITLE + ": " + (subject if len(subject) <= MAX_SUBJECT else subject[:MAX_SUBJECT].rstrip() + "...") else: subject = TITLE + ": " + str(len(requests)) + " requests - " + date # the owner's own copies, from Routines; Collaboration checked the addresses when the owner saved them cc = [str(a).strip() for a in scope.get("cc") or [] if str(a).strip().lower() != recipient.lower()] pixel = "MicrosoftOutlookSendMail(" + ", ".join([ _pixel_value("to", [recipient]), *([_pixel_value("cc", cc)] if cc else []), _pixel_value("subject", subject), _pixel_value("body", body), _pixel_value("html", True), ]) + ");" ret = Insight().run_pixel(pixel, raw=True) last = ret[0]["pixelReturn"][-1] if "ERROR" in str(last.get("operationType")): raise RuntimeError("Sending the review failed: " + str(last.get("output"))) return {"sent": True, "to": recipient, "cc": cc, "subject": subject, "html": body, "drafts": drafts}
